unmatched_gold.text: A response-related meeting was held in Nerridge, and the Provincial Building Safety Board later met.

pairs.gold_text: Community support was organized in Imber Street during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Community members offered support at Imber Street.

pairs.gold_text: Deaths were reported in connection with the Aldan House collapse by November 8.
Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
Nerridge fire service reported rescuing nine people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.

unmatched_gold.text: PUSAR reported rescuing people on November 4 and again on November 6.

pairs.gold_text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.

unmatched_gold.text: Later safety updates stated that the west wing had not collapsed.
Authorities reported no damage to adjacent structures in connection with the Aldan House collapse.
The tower crane at the site was reported not to have fallen.
Later updates reported restoration of the tower crane in Imber Street and restoration of Aldan House.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Aldan House was disrupted; later, services were reported closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row.
pairs.system_text: Service at Aldan House was disrupted.

pairs.gold_text: About 85 people were reported displaced from Cobbett Row during the later phase of the response.
pairs.system_text: People were displaced from Cobbett Row.

unmatched_gold.text: Dangerous conditions were reported at Cobbett Row while local services remained closed.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge Police deployed in the city during the later phase of the response.
